{"code":"import random

def generate(rng):
    h=rng.randint(3,8)
    w=rng.randint(3,8)
    # Sparse multicolor rectangular grids, typical of abstract grid tasks.
    palette=[0,1,2,3,4]
    return [[rng.choice(palette) if rng.random()<0.35 else 0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]"}
